title: Hidden eye patterns on product packaging

tellings.quote: what I have done with companies is you can make something that's I like. But not obviously I like.

plain: The cognitive scientist Don Hoffman tells Michels that he has worked with companies to design things, such as product packaging, that hold an eye-like pattern without being obviously eye-like. He tells it from his own work, as an example of how designs can tug at what the brain notices without the viewer being aware of it.
